_comment: The one list of local services: the portal page renders it, portal/status.py checks it every 30 s. check.type: http (any HTTP answer = up), tcp (port accepts a connection), file (path exists). {ROOT} = the project folder.

services.name: dbt docs
services.desc: Model docs, tests and lineage graph. Runs on demand.
services.start: cd {ROOT}\warehouse\dbt; uv run dbt docs generate --profiles-dir .; uv run dbt docs serve --profiles-dir . --port 8081

services.name: DuckDB UI
services.desc: SQL notebook over warehouse.duckdb. Pause Airflow first: DuckDB allows one writer.
services.start: cd {ROOT}\warehouse\dbt; uv run python -c "import duckdb; c=duckdb.connect('../../warehouse.duckdb'); c.execute('INSTALL ui; LOAD ui; CALL start_ui()'); input('Enter to stop')"

services.name: Redpanda admin API
services.desc: Broker health. Kafka clients use localhost:9092.

services.name: RedisInsight
services.desc: Online feature store. Database 'mpp features (online store)' is already added.

services.name: Feature consumer metrics
services.desc: Events processed, duplicates, late, lag. Only while the consumer runs.
services.start: cd {ROOT}\streaming; uv run python consumer.py --score-url http://127.0.0.1:8091/score

services.name: MLflow
services.desc: Experiment 'fraud' and the fraud model registry (champion / challenger).

services.name: Fraud scorer on Kubernetes
services.desc: Helm release fraud-scorer in namespace fraud: 2-5 pods behind a NodePort, autoscaled on CPU.

services.name: Grafana
services.desc: Dashboard 'Payments platform': freshness, scoring SLOs, streaming, drift, alerts. No login.

services.name: Prometheus
services.desc: Runs in the kind cluster; bridged to localhost:9090. Alert rules and SLO recording rules.

services.name: Freshness & drift exporter
services.desc: Data age per layer (source, raw, mart) and feature PSI vs training data.

services.name: LiteLLM gateway
services.desc: Every LLM call: per-team keys, budgets, rate limits, PII redaction, audit log. Login admin / LITELLM_MASTER_KEY.

services.name: Postgres (source)
services.desc: user/password payments · databases payments, airflow, litellm
